current_command.command: npm run check:coding-tools-history && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$shm='.coding-tools/orchestration/ledger.sqlite3-shm'; $wal='.coding-tools/orchestration/ledger.sqlite3-wal'; $deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(10); while(((Test-Path $shm) -or (Test-Path $wal)) -and ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25 }; if((Test-Path $shm) -or (Test-Path $wal)){ exit 3 }" && git add -A -- .coding-tools && git add -- docs/research/260818_P3_SERVER_FIRST_PAIRED_EXPERIMENT_MANIFEST.md && npm run check:coding-tools-delivery && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$shm='.coding-tools/orchestration/ledger.sqlite3-shm'; $wal='.coding-tools/orchestration/ledger.sqlite3-wal'; $deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(10); while(((Test-Path $shm) -or (Test-Path $wal)) -and ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25 }; if((Test-Path $shm) -or (Test-Path $wal)){ exit 3 }" && git add -A -- .coding-tools && npm run check:coding-tools-delivery && git diff --cached --check && git commit -m "Freeze P3 server-first pilot manifest" && git push origin main
